concerns.text: FR-001 mandates ingesting data from NIST/UCI/OpenML repositories. No task fetches or ingests any external dataset: T002 loads only the two bundled raw files, and T002's claim that 'the external-repository gap is handled in T013' is misdirected — T013 is a spec-revision task, not a data-acquisition task. FR-001's ingestion clause has no delivering task; either add a fetch task or amend FR-001 via T013 to explicitly descope external ingestion (currently T013 only records the gap, it does not rewrite the MUST-ingest clause).

Plan Phase 1 requires running `src/data/gen_synthetic.py` (deterministic seed 42) to produce `data/raw/synthetic_fatigue.csv` (10 000 rows). No task implements or runs the generator: T001 only checksums the file and T002 loads it as a bundled input. The file's creation is an orphaned plan element with no owning task; on a fresh clone the pipeline cannot run.

FR-006/FR-007 and SC-001/SC-003 require bootstrap mediation with proportion mediated and 95% CIs. T009 implements it only conditionally, and T008's eligibility gate (real open dataset, ≥50 measured rows, synthetic never eligible) combined with the absence of any external-data task means mediation is structurally always skipped. T013 amends only FR-003 and FR-001, not FR-006/FR-007, so the spec never authorizes the permanent-skip outcome. Add a task (or extend T013) that amends FR-006/FR-007/SC-001/SC-003 to the conditional/skip semantics, or add a task that can actually satisfy them.

US-1 scenario 2 requires parsing a nested-JSON dataset from OpenML. T002 covers nested-JSON parsing only against a repo-bundled fixture (`code/tests/fixtures/openml_style_nested.json`). The parsing logic is covered, but the OpenML-source aspect has no task; fold this into the FR-001 resolution (fetch task or explicit descope in T013's FR-001 amendment).
